title.quote: Personalized Negative Reservoir for Incremental Learning in Recommender Systems

analysis.description: This paper presents a novel strategy called Personalized Negative Reservoir to improve incremental learning in recommender systems. It addresses the issue of 'catastrophic forgetting' by introducing a negative sampling technique that is personalized based on user interest shifts over time. The approach integrates with state-of-the-art incremental recommendation models to enhance their performance in terms of recommendation accuracy.

type.justification: The paper involves empirical evaluations and comparisons of the proposed method with state-of-the-art models across multiple datasets, which is indicative of empirical research.
type.quote: We show that these concrete realizations of our negative reservoir framework achieve state-of-the-art results in standard benchmarks, on multiple standard top-k evaluation metrics.
